scope: Internal discovery leads only. Listed, claimed partner and transcript-recipient evidence does not establish transfer acceptance, regional accreditation, campus availability or a complete degree plan.

methodology.thresholdMeaning: Research priorities only. A lower-transfer route can be valuable for a desired campus; neither percentage overrides evidence, source caps, or student goals.
methodology.accreditationGate: Verify current accreditation by the user-approved regional institutional accrediting bodies. All directory-only candidates remain unreviewed.
methodology.capSeparation: Overall transfer ceiling, ACE/noncollegiate combined allowance and actually mapped degree credits are independent facts.
methodology.studentVisibility: No discovery candidate enters the degree picker or becomes a ready template from this artifact.
methodology.identity: Conservative exact-name/acronym normalization. Similar systems, campuses, online divisions and historical names are not silently merged.
methodology.sourceCounts: Provider marketing counts and transcript recipients are not verified acceptance totals.

sources.label: Homeschooling for College Credit provider matrix
sources.note: The table is dated April 20, 2021. Its marked provider relationships are historical third-party research leads, not current university agreements. Historical names, operating status, accreditation, program scope and exact transfer policies require current institutional evidence.

sources.label: Saylor credit partners
sources.note: The official credit-partner page returned a JavaScript shell. No institution list was extractable from the cached response; no source relationships were invented.

sources.label: Sophia school finder
sources.note: The public page distinguishes 115+ partner institutions from 2,900+ institutions that have received transcripts for review. Its school finder is dynamic; neither group was extracted as a verified acceptance list. No static sample recipient was imported as a partner.

sources.label: StraighterLine college directory
sources.note: Named links to individual college pages were extracted, deduplicated and retained as directory-listed research leads only. This is not an exhaustive current partnership, accreditation or transfer-acceptance inventory; decorative logos and generic links were ignored.

sources.label: Study.com school directory
sources.note: The official school directory returned HTTP 403. No school-level relationships were extracted; marketing totals are not treated as acceptance evidence.
